chunks: And al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
"Linen was for the Children of Israel; they would be shrouded in it, and cotton is for the Ummah of Muhammad, peace be upon him and his family."

key_terms.أُمَّةِ مُحَمَّدٍ: the community of Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله, meaning the Muslim Ummah
key_terms.الْقُطْنُ: cotton, identified here as the shrouding material for the Muslim community
key_terms.الْكَتَّانُ: linen, identified here as the shrouding material used by the Children of Israel
key_terms.بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ: the Children of Israel, the earlier community referenced for comparison
key_terms.يُكَفَّنُونَ: they were shrouded, referring to burial wrapping of the deceased

ai.seo_question: What fabric is mentioned for shrouding in the Ummah of Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that linen was the shrouding fabric used among the Children of Israel, whereas cotton is for the Ummah of Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله. The report has juristic significance in the discussion of burial and shrouding practices, while also noting a distinction between earlier communities and the Islamic Ummah.
